items.title: Regulators unveil a tiered framework for high-risk AI systems
items.summary: Officials proposed a tiered framework that would impose audits and incident reporting on the highest-risk AI deployments. Lower-risk tools would face only transparency rules. Industry groups welcomed the clarity while warning the audit burden could slow smaller firms.

items.title: Hardware maker debuts a thinner foldable with a day-long battery
items.summary: A major hardware maker unveiled its thinnest foldable yet, pairing a lighter hinge with a battery it says lasts a full day of heavy use. Reviewers praised the crease reduction but flagged the premium price. Pre-orders open ahead of the holiday quarter.

items.title: Stocks climb as inflation cools more than forecast
items.summary: Equities advanced after a softer-than-expected inflation reading revived bets on a near-term rate cut. Technology and real estate led the rally while energy slipped with crude. Treasury yields fell across the curve as traders repriced policy.

items.title: Robotics lab raises mega-round to train foundation models for machines
items.summary: A robotics lab closed a large round to build foundation models that control physical machines from shared sensor data. Investors are betting that a single model can generalize across warehouse and household tasks. The company plans to license the model to hardware partners.

items.title: Struggling club parts ways with its manager after winless run
items.summary: A club near the relegation zone dismissed its manager following a winless run that left it short of expectations. The board installed a caretaker while it sounds out replacements. Supporters were split on whether the squad or the tactics were to blame.

items.title: Weekend Metro closures to disrupt Orange and Silver line service
items.summary: The transit authority announced weekend track work that will shut several Arlington stations on the Orange and Silver lines. Shuttle buses will bridge the closed segments during the project. Officials urged riders to budget extra travel time through the end of the month.
